card.name: Inside split-up long words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer word or name that is split across several parts, such as Hel|ium, SU|IC|IDAL, eff|erv|escence, Dar|ling. The word is often capitalised or in a name.

modes.label: Split common words
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer ordinary word such as helium, effervescence or eyebrow.

modes.label: Capitalised warning words
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps word in a label warning heading, such as suicidality.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS SU<<IC>>IDALITY AND ANTIDEPRESS

modes.label: Names and web addresses
modes.description: A middle piece of a proper name or site address.

card.plain: It fires partway through a long word that has been broken into pieces, such as a name or a capitalised warning word.
